summary: Mobile Stripe parity verification for participant Add/Remove + billing endpoints against the shared backend. Backend pytest 13/14 pass (1 seed-state issue: mark.adviser account is currently on Family plan in this preview env, so /v2/participants/preview returns branch=covered_by_family instead of adviser_included — not a code bug). Mobile UI on the Expo web preview end-to-end verified: cathy (Family, 3 active) taps Add participant → POST /v2/participants/preview?count=1 returns branch=family_addons → modal shows stepper + live cost summary with correct math (count=1 → '2 × $24.50 = $49.00 added, base $49.50, New total: $98.50 per fortnight'; count=2 → '3 × $24.50 = $73.50 added, New total: $123.00 per fortnight'). Continue → form step → fill → form-submit-add → done step shows forwarding email + Pay $24.50/fortnight add-on btn + Skip payment btn. Tapping pay-addon-btn opens a real https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... URL via WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync — verified via popup event. Remove flow with 4 active (>2) opens remove-participant-modal with 60-day retention note and NO downgrade options (correct — canDowngradeOnRemove only fires when Family + exactly 2 active + non-primary target); confirm-remove hits DELETE /v2/participants/{id} and returns PENDING_REMOVAL + data_purge_scheduled_at. Fire-and-forget /payments/sync-plan-to-participants returned 200. All billing endpoints (/billing/subscription, /payments/portal, /payments/checkout, /billing/trial-eligibility, /billing/cancel, /reactivate-subscription, /billing/v2/upgrade-checkout, /billing/v2/addon-checkout, /billing/v2/cancel-pending-addon) respond without 500 and return Stripe URLs where expected. Full parity with web /app/participants observed.

minor.issue: mark.adviser@example.com in this preview env is on FAMILY plan (base_price_monthly=49.5, addons_needed=0), so preview returns branch='covered_by_family' instead of 'adviser_included'. Not a code bug — the mobile UI correctly handles the adviser_included branch (renders branch-adviser view). Re-seed mark.adviser to plan='adviser' to exercise this branch.

action_items: (Optional / env-only) Re-seed mark.adviser@example.com to plan='adviser' so the branch=adviser_included path can be exercised end-to-end via preview. The mobile code path (participants.tsx branch-adviser) is already wired.

(Optional / nit) participants.tsx line 422: Pay button label says 'Pay $24.50 per fortnight add-on now' but when count>1 (e.g., stepper set to 2, or user already has multiple addons_needed) the created addon can be >$24.50. Consider using the dynamic total from preview or lastAdded.addon when available so the button reflects the actual charge, matching the summary card.
critical_code_review_comments: participants.tsx openAdd() always calls preview?count=1 — but the stepper allows count up to 10; only refreshPreview() is called on ± presses, which is correct. Good.
participants.tsx confirmRemove() body sends {downgrade: removeChoice==='downgrade'} — matches web contract. Good.
participants.tsx canDowngradeOnRemove uses `basePlan === 'FAMILY' && active.length === 2 && !removeTarget.is_primary` — matches web condition exactly. Good.
participants.tsx uses `apiFetch('/payments/sync-plan-to-participants', ...).catch(() => {})` fire-and-forget — matches web behavior. Good.
participants.tsx skip-payment flow calls /billing/v2/cancel-pending-addon then closeAdd+loadAll — correct rollback path.
Mobile plan-select correctly calls /api/payments/checkout with {plan, origin_url, trial_days} and opens the returned url via WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync — parity with web Signup/Pricing.
File size participants.tsx is 490 lines — within limit.
